page_title: Network related--WiFi parameters configured correctly but unable to connect
page_content:
Why can’t I connect if the WiFi parameters are correctly configured, and why can’t I obtain an IP address? As shown below:
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d9685451c8ceb6738148113abfee46bd)

Troubleshooting steps:
1. Use a new Android phone or enter a WiFi router to check whether the connected WiFi is in the 5G band. Conventional batch-shipped devices are all 2.4g WiFi modules, so they cannot use the 5G WiFi network. If necessary, contact our staff to replace the 5G WiFi module.
